'''Fizzzz''' was an [[Alcohol/Legends|alcoholic]] beverage favoured by [[Wyle Ulbreck]], a [[Moisture farmer/Legends|moisture farmer]] from [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], he bought a bottle of Fizzzz in [[Dannar's Claim]].
